primaryMetric: main-thread script CPU ms per frame, CDP Performance threadTicks; cumulative counters sampled at window boundaries
secondaryMetrics: main-thread task CPU ms per frame
regressionBudget: renderer p95 max(5% control,0.3ms); paired mean excess 95% interval must be <=0
shippingCriterion: Positive lower bound of the primary improvement interval; no reproducible renderer CPU budget breach. Otherwise report unqualified and do not claim an improvement.
policy: Fixed 20 pairs, all included; no outcome-based extension or exclusions. Screening/profile/per-call counters/builds/unit runs excluded. CPU counters are boundary-only and enabled identically in both variants.
